item.title: Version 1.1.10
item.description:
What's New in StockDeck 1.1.10

  • Valuation & Profitability Metrics: Added Key Statistics including P/E, Forward P/E, P/B, Dividend Yield, EPS, Market Cap, ROE, ROA, ROIC, Profit Margin, PEG, and Debt/Equity in symbol and holding details.
  • Customizable Valuation Columns: Added Valuation metrics to Watchlist and Portfolio tables with full sorting and column selection.
  • Vietnamese Stock Valuation: Integrated Yahoo Finance valuation fundamentals for Vietnamese (.VN) equities with zero additional network requests.
  • Streamlined Symbol Details: Cleaned up redundant range cards for a focused, responsive layout.
